sloka: एष दत्त्वा च वित्तानि प्राप्य च अनुत्तमम् यशः ।लोकनाथः पुरा भूत्वा सुग्रीवम् नाथम् इच्छति ॥४-४-१८॥
transliteration: eṣa dattvā ca vittāni prāpya ca anuttamam yaśaḥ ।lokanāthaḥ purā bhūtvā sugrīvam nātham icchati ॥4-4-18॥

translations.english: 'Having earned supreme fame through his munificence in the past, this lord of the world now craves Sugriva's indulgence.
